activity_summary: The loaf was a penny and a full thumb short. Board was threepence because you sat to it, and she would not make a week of one dinner. You ate three bites and left the desk upstairs. The quire stayed blank. The coffer stayed shut. Fivepence had not come out of it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate the soft of the loaf, and left the quire blank.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Priced the sitting once, and would not have a second loaf.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Put the rest under the cloth, and left the paper blank.
